audience: fitness and wellness studio owners and front-desk staff who run classes and memberships in Momence

useCases.title: See the class schedule and how full each class is
useCases.text: The AI lists scheduled sessions (classes, events, courses) in a date window with time, teacher, location, capacity and booking count. You see which classes are full or empty.

useCases.title: Check who is booked into a class
useCases.text: The AI lists the roster of one session with each booking's member and check-in state. It can also show the waitlist size from the session details.

useCases.title: Look up a member's bookings and memberships
useCases.text: The AI finds a member by name, email or phone, then lists their class bookings and their active memberships with dates, credits left and freeze state.

useCases.title: Review sales leads and membership plans
useCases.text: The AI lists leads by source or pipeline stage, and the membership plans the studio sells with pricing, duration and credits. You can see open leads and what you offer.

useCases.title: Check in, book, waitlist or cancel a class spot
useCases.text: The AI checks a booking in or out, books a member into a session as a comp booking, adds them to a waitlist, or cancels one booking. A cancel can refund and notify the member.
